effects: Takes exactly `assets` wARS (0x0DC4…D90D, the vault asset) from the signer via transferFrom, using the signer's existing approval to the vault.
Mints vault shares (KPK_wARS_Yield) to `onBehalf`; the count is previewDeposit(assets), set by the vault's share price after accrueInterest. There is no minimum.
formats.shown: Deposit the exact wARS amount into the KPK_wARS_Yield vault, with shares sent to the onBehalf address; the share count is not shown.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares minted is not shown; the vault computes it from its share price.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit(): `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`. Case 0 minted 1629547.83 KPK_wARS_Yield, which is not on the screen. The calldata has no share amount or minimum, so no descriptor can show it.
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor. A label could note that shares are minted at the current share price.

findings.title: deposit: the interpolated intent leaves out that vault shares come back, and 'Share ticker' is a separate raw constant field.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit interpolatedIntent "Deposit {#.assets} for {#.onBehalf}"; field 'Share ticker' value $.metadata.constants.vaultTicker (raw).
findings.fix: Use "Deposit {#.assets} into KPK_wARS_Yield, shares to {#.onBehalf}" and drop the standalone ticker field.

cases.notes: wARS out: amount, asset and vault are right. Shares in: the reader knew the recipient and the ticker but not the amount, which only the vault decides.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Sends exactly `assets` wARS from the vault to `receiver`.
Burns previewWithdraw(assets) vault shares from `onBehalf`. The count is rounded up at the current share price, with no maximum.
When msg.sender != onBehalf, the caller's share allowance from onBehalf goes down by the shares burned, unless it is infinite.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly the given wARS amount to the receiver, from the Owner's position; the shares burned are not shown.

findings.title: withdraw: the shares burned from the owner are not shown; the vault computes the count from its share price.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw(): `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets); exit(...)` → `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)`. Case 1 burned 49970.45 KPK_wARS_Yield from the signer, which is not on the screen.
findings.fix: None for the amount. The calldata has no share bound.

findings.title: withdraw: nothing on the screen says the Owner's KPK_wARS_Yield shares are burned to pay for this withdrawal.
findings.evidence: descriptor withdraw fields: 'Withdraw exactly', 'To', 'Owner'; interpolatedIntent "Withdraw {#.assets} to {#.receiver}". Case 1 reader: 'the screen doesn't show what is given up (likely vault shares/position in KPK)'.
findings.fix: Relabel onBehalf to 'Burn KPK_wARS_Yield shares from', or use "Withdraw {#.assets} from KPK_wARS_Yield vault (shares of {#.onBehalf}) to {#.receiver}".

cases.notes: wARS in: exact amount and receiver are right. Shares out: the reader only guessed that vault shares are given up and did not know the amount.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns exactly `shares` vault shares (KPK_wARS_Yield) from `onBehalf`, spending the caller's share allowance when the caller is not onBehalf.
Sends previewRedeem(shares) wARS from the vault to `receiver`. The amount is set by the current share price, with no minimum.
formats.shown: Redeem the exact KPK_wARS_Yield share amount from the Owner to the receiver; the asset and amount paid out are not shown.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never says the payout is wARS, though the descriptor has it as a constant.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol exit(): `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets)`. The asset is wARS (constructor _asset 0x0DC4…D90D = metadata.constants.underlyingToken). descriptor redeem interpolatedIntent "Redeem {#.shares} to {#.receiver}" names no output asset. Case 2 reader: 'The screen does not say which asset or how much.'
findings.fix: Use "Redeem {#.shares} for wARS to {#.receiver}" and/or label receiver 'wARS sent to'.

findings.title: redeem: the wARS amount received is computed by the vault and has no minimum, so it cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol redeem(): `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares);`. Case 2 paid out 100.000000001 wARS, which is not on the screen. The calldata has no min-out.

cases.notes: Shares out: right. wARS in: the reader knew some underlying asset arrives at their address, but not that it is wARS or how much.

withdraw(uint256 assets, address receive.worst: withdraw: nothing on the screen says the Owner's KPK_wARS_Yield shares are burned to pay for this withdrawal.

redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver,.worst: redeem: the screen never says the payout is wARS, though the descriptor has it as a constant.

summary.worst: redeem: the screen never says the payout is wARS, though the descriptor has it as a constant.
